title: ArtifactAttestation
description: Produced-artifact provenance record — links an artifact to the run and tool that produced it.

digest.description: Content digest of the artifact (e.g. sha256:<hex>).

produced_by_run_id.description: run_id of the AEP record that produced this artifact.

tool_name.description: Name of the tool that produced the artifact.

signature.description: Optional tamper-evident signature over the attestation.
